scientific.integrity: The primary publisher PDF was inspected at the model equations, reproduction number, endemic-equilibrium polynomial, Lemma 3.1, and backward-bifurcation section; the relevant Lemma page was visually inspected. A related open full-text vector-borne paper with saturated rates was inspected for equilibrium-root classification. Exact coefficient signs and a two-equilibrium witness were independently replayed from the original five equations. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result corrects endemic-equilibrium multiplicity for the printed saturated-treatment model. It does not classify stability of the two subthreshold endemic equilibria, complete the backward-bifurcation diagram, or assess the later optimal-control system. The explicit witness is mathematically admissible rather than epidemiologically calibrated.

title: Correct endemic-equilibrium multiplicity for a saturated-treatment vector–host model
